OptionCheck.description:
Option-level ground truth: a specific option the run should have carded.
The M2 Trap-2 divergence was an option-level scouting miss the angle-level
metric alone cannot catch ('compression' appeared in zero cards), so specs
that know a ground-truth option carry a mechanical carded-at-all check.

evidence_terms.description: Case-insensitive substrings searched over every option card's text; any match marks the option as plausibly carded (candidates are listed for the human to confirm).
evidence_terms.title: Evidence Terms

expectation.description: What the withheld prior says should happen — recorded, never settled by the eval (adjudication stays the user's).
expectation.title: Expectation

OptionCheck.title: OptionCheck

ReferenceAngle.description:
One angle of a benchmark's reference union (design §10 breadth: 'built
once per benchmark question by an exhaustive manual + multi-tool pass').

practitioner_obvious.description: Missing this angle draws the design's explicit penalty flag: 'penalty for missing any angle a domain practitioner would consider obvious'.
practitioner_obvious.title: Practitioner Obvious

ReferenceAngle.title: ReferenceAngle

ReferenceProvenance.description:
How a reference angle entered the benchmark's union. The distinction is
load-bearing: a HUMAN_ADDED angle was missed by the original run's ensemble
and added at Gate A — a fresh run is scored on producing it WITHOUT help
(the 'practitioner-obvious miss' test case, M2 notes F3).
ReferenceProvenance.title: ReferenceProvenance

description: One benchmarks/<id>.yaml question spec (design §10's 4-6 question set).

type.description: Question shape tag (design §10): personal-decision, technical-selection, open-advice — suffixed '-known-ground-truth' where the user holds a withheld prior.
type.title: Type

profile.description: Run profile the benchmark is calibrated for.
profile.title: Profile

fixtures.description: Where reusable run artifacts live (kept locally, gitignored) and any caveats about their formats.
fixtures.title: Fixtures

reference_angles.description: The reference angle union; empty until a first run seeds it.
reference_angles.title: Reference Angles

ground_truth.description: What is actually known vs what remains the user's adjudication — recorded exactly, never settled by the eval.
ground_truth.title: Ground Truth

cost_calibration.description: Observed spend checkpoints for this question/profile.
cost_calibration.title: Cost Calibration

baseline_file.description: Path (relative to this spec) where a plain Deep Research answer to the same question can be pasted for `deeper eval --compare-baseline`.
baseline_file.title: Baseline File

title: BenchmarkSpec
